reflections.summary: Lost because the rain core (Pelipper+Swampert-Mega) was fundamentally mismatched into this opponent. Cloud Nine Altaria nullified rain's value, Rotom-Wash Thunderbolt OHKO'd Pelipper (4x), and Floette-Mega Energy Ball OHKO'd Swampert-Mega (4x). Houndoom was the only Floette answer but got chipped to sash by Moonblast and couldn't survive long enough to trade. By turn 5 the entire team was fainted or at 1%. The four brought and the Swampert-Mega pick lost at team preview.
reflections.adjustment: Do not bring Pelipper+Swampert-Mega into Cloud Nine Altaria + Energy Ball Floette-Mega + Thunderbolt Rotom-Wash. Pick a different Mega and a different weather-independent core. If Houndoom is the only Floette-Mega answer, it needs a partner that can remove or weaken Floette before Houndoom is forced to take a hit. Prioritize speed control or priority that doesn't depend on rain.
